meta.name: How to Get Rich
meta.description:
Money holds power over us — but it doesn't have to. Finance expert Ramit Sethi works with people across the US to help them achieve their richest lives.

Rated TV-14 · Ended · First aired 18 Apr 2023 · United Kingdom · Language: English · 40 min

Complete series. On your server: S1 8/8

On your server — Audio: English

videos.title: Design Your Rich Life
videos.overview: Have you ever wondered how much people make and how much they spend? Three families meet with Ramit and put their financial histories in his hands.

videos.title: Financial Hot Water
videos.overview: Twelve credit cards between two people, a potential $1.3 million lost to interest and fees — these money missteps give Ramit lots to work with.

videos.title: HOA Not Okay
videos.overview: Ramit debates the merits of home ownership. Then, he helps a couple work better together and evaluates one family's conscious spending habits.

videos.title: New Cash, Old Problems
videos.overview: To give a couple a taste of the rich life, Ramit takes them on a fantasy getaway. Then, he meets with a reality star who needs help with his spending.

videos.title: Pet Checking Accounts
videos.overview: A recently engaged drag performer living paycheck to paycheck needs to get his finances in order. A couple with a good portfolio makes risky investments.

videos.title: Mult-Level Marketing Madness
videos.overview: Ramit helps a couple who say they're financial opposites to plan for their wedding. Next, he broaches the topic of multilevel marketing with a client.

videos.title: Bills & Wedding Bells
videos.overview: One couple has an honest dialogue about credit card debt, while another throws their wedding budget out the window upon finding the dream dress.

videos.title: Destination Rich Life
videos.overview: One couple learns to speak the same financial language, another makes a plan to pay off personal debt and a third achieves their financial dream.
